title: The birthday paradox
description:
Only 23 people. One room. And a 50.7% chance that two people share the same birthday. 🎂

Sounds impossible, but the mathematics is real.

The secret? We're not comparing everyone's birthday with yours. We're comparing every possible pair of people.

Try this with your friends or colleagues.

Did you expect the probability to be this high?
